content: GoatCounter integration snippet (from github.com/arp242/goatcounter README, goatcounter.com down): <script data-goatcounter="https://MYCODE.goatcounter.com/count" async src="//gc.zgo.at/count.js"></script>. count.js (public/count.js) filters by default: localhost/private-IP hostnames and file: protocol (unless allow_local), iframes (unless allow_frame), webdriver/Phantom/Nightmare/Selenium bots, prerender visibilityState, localStorage skipgc=t via #toggle-goatcounter hash. No DNT handling. no_onload/no_events settings exist.
